metadata.title: Tidal Disruption Flares from Recoiling Supermassive Black Holes

notes: No eligible stars. The paper discusses stellar populations around recoiling supermassive black holes generically (e.g., T:p1-b13 and T:p2-b16), but does not identify any individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate. The only individually named object, SDSSJ092712.65+294344.0 (T:p1-b11), is a quasar/supermassive-black-hole recoil candidate, not a Galactic unbound star. Its “unbound stars” are stars unbound from the recoiling black hole or its host system, not identified Milky Way unbound stars.
